authorization: User requested strengthening the paper and conducting necessary additional experiments on 2026-10-21 after reading the critical assessment.
question: Does a tenfold change in continuation optimizer learning rate change the paired effect of fixed MSE or CWD distillation, and does the previously observed low-rate pattern replicate in three additional starting pairs?
historical_status: The original 3-pair results were known when this extension was designed. This is a disclosed follow-up, not a retroactive preregistration of all six pairs. All original strengths/results remain reported.

data.provenance: Reconstructed legacy 2018-format mirror, not authenticated official-host Detection 2020 labels. Original labels and completed studies are immutable.

base.endpoint: final epoch 100 EMA last.pt; never validation best.pt
base.independence_scope: Six new BDD fine-tuning runs from fixed official COCO checkpoints, not six independently pretrained COCO models. Independent base training seeds affect head initialization and data/augmentation. Three matched pairs are the unit of replication.
base.native_loader_correction: Preflight found Ultralytics 8.2.103 hard-codes its training-loader generator independently of args.seed. Before full training, replace only the training loader with a standard finite PyTorch DataLoader; set generator to pair_seed + 100003 * zero-based epoch, recreate workers each epoch and retain native dataset/augmentations/optimizer/validation. Save full-precision model, EMA, optimizer, scaler, scheduler and RNG sidecars for technical resume.

factorial.coefficient_rationale: 0.3 is the log-midpoint of the original prespecified 0.03/0.3/3 grid, not the observed best coefficient. No coefficient or learning-rate search is performed.
factorial.lr_rationale: One fixed tenfold perturbation of the prior initial learning rate isolates optimizer-rate sensitivity without changing epochs, data, teacher, adapter, clipping, loss normalization or augmentation. The same rate applies to student and adapters; their effects are not separately identified.
factorial.reuse: For seeds101/202/303 reuse the completed low-rate control and weight0.3 MSE/CWD paths at epochs20/40 with exact original checkpoint/evaluation hashes. Never rerun these paths.
factorial.new_jobs: For historical seeds run only the high-rate three arms (9). For each new seed run both rates and all three arms (18).
primary_contrasts: For MSE: (MSE-control at lr0.001) minus (MSE-control at lr0.0001) within each pair at epoch40.
For CWD: (CWD-control at lr0.001) minus (CWD-control at lr0.0001) within each pair at epoch40.
factorial.analysis: Report all six paired interactions and mean/sampleSD/range. Report old and new three-pair strata separately. Six-pair 95% t intervals (df5) are descriptive model-based uncertainty with normality/small-sample limits, not multiplicity-adjusted significance or equivalence decisions. All simple effects and epoch20 endpoints are secondary; no winning rate/method selected.

training.lr_schedule: cosine over the prespecified 40-epoch trajectory, final multiplier 0.1
training.data_seed_rule: pair seed + 1000; identical per-epoch sampler and augmentation across all seven trajectories within a pair
training.teacher: corresponding independently fine-tuned large model, frozen and in eval mode
training.trainability: all student parameters except DFL projection; fresh 1x1 feature adapters; adapters discarded for inference
training.endpoint: final EMA at fixed epochs, no best checkpoint or best coefficient selection
training.interpretation: The epoch-20 endpoint is nested in a 40-epoch schedule, not a separately optimized 20-epoch schedule. Equal coefficient values do not imply equal objective or gradient strength. Report all six paired effects and their loss scales.

gradient_probe.purpose: Measure detection and weighted feature-gradient norms and cosine alignment on the same student parameters; loss ratios alone cannot establish optimization influence.
gradient_probe.scope: All36 factorial continuation paths at epoch40, using preserved raw student/adapter states, including existing9 raw final states; no claim to reconstruct historical per-step gradients.
gradient_probe.data: Two fixed batches of32 training images chosen solely by SHA256 ordering of gradient_probe_20261021 plus filename; no validation/KITTI images; deterministic square640 geometry without random augmentation.
gradient_probe.precision: FP32 eval-mode, autograd enabled, teacher detached. Fixed-model diagnostic, not the actual stochastic AMP training gradient.
gradient_probe.outputs: Detection gradient norm, feature gradient norm, weighted gradient norm, dot product, cosine, ratio, per-layer-group summaries, teacher no-grad, exact input/state hashes. Undefined/zero/nonfinite values explicitly recorded.
gradient_probe.state_safety: Separate process loaded from immutable saved states; no optimizer update, no training-state or EMA mutation; each probe checks model buffers before/after.
gradient_probe.budget: 72 fixed batch probes plus bounded synthetic correctness fixtures; maximum6 GPU-hours, no additional batches chosen by results.

metric_decomposition.purpose: Isolate overlap/integration/ignore-definition sensitivity while keeping predictions and all other scoring elements fixed.
metric_decomposition.scope: All48 final factorial endpoints (12 base references and36 epoch40 students) on KITTI preserved prediction archives; no fresh inference for this analysis.
metric_decomposition.controls: Same COCO matching/interpolation envelope, class mapping, all-image population, no difficulty filtering and maxDet300 in every cell. Factor effects and full interaction table retained. This controlled alternate scorer does NOT reproduce native KITTI rules; nativeKITTI remains a separate endpoint.
metric_decomposition.validation: Known-answer synthetic IoU boundary, recall-grid and ignore fixtures and exact reproduction of prior common AP in matching cells must pass before actual rescoring. Implement/freeze source before new metric results.

evaluation.primary: BDD100K ten-class AP50:95 on reconstructed legacy validation labels
evaluation.external: Previously examined KITTI public labeled training partition, 7481 images, Car and Pedestrian; no external score used for coefficient, epoch or model selection. Do not call it a new untouched test or official hidden test.
evaluation.harmonization: Before new external scoring, implement and synthetically verify a common two-class AP evaluator with the same IoU grid and integration rule on BDD and KITTI. Preserve native KITTI scores separately. Document remaining annotation/ignore/sequence differences; harmonization cannot establish a causal domain-shift mechanism.
evaluation.roster: All six base endpoints and all 21 continuation trajectories at epochs 20 and 40; no selective external reporting.

execution.budget_accounting: Count elapsed time of every GPU subprocess including preflight/probes/evaluation and retries. Check elapsed/remaining cap before dispatch; terminate own current job at cap only after preserving its last atomic state. Stop further dispatch; report incomplete cells without replacing them.
execution.preflight: Hash every source and original checkpoint; verify all label hashes and cached loader cardinality, exact observational AMP-counter parity with native optimizer, injected AMP skip accounting, four native seed/architecture smoke runs, both rates/all3arms actual-image update/input parity, finite state, detached teacher, interrupted continuation replay exact-state parity.
execution.resume: Technical interruptions only with unchanged frozen sources/conditions and atomic RNG/optimizer/scaler state. Keep all failure records. No automatic retry of scientific divergence or nonfinite objective; preserve and report such a cell. No restart of completed jobs.
execution.base_queue: Run six new bases only after BASE_PREFLIGHT_PASSED. Continuation dispatch separately gated on CONTINUATION_PREFLIGHT_PASSED and completed base audits; no unfinished code auto-runs.
execution.stop: The fixed6bases+27continuations,60new endpoints,36fixed gradient probes,384metric cells, numerical verification and revised documents/GitHub complete, or the hard budget is reached. Do not extend the grid to obtain improvement.

instrumentation.base: Actual optimizer attempts and actual step-post-hook counts; preserve native EMA behavior including native attempted-step EMA updates. New counters are observational, not algorithm changes.
instrumentation.continuation: Preserve original optimizer/scaler/EMA behavior. Add actual optimizer post-hook counts, per-batch finite/unclipped-gradient/clipping records, all-epoch state digests and full raw sidecars at10/20/40. Verify observational parity before training.
instrumentation.historical_limits: Existing base counters and intermediate raw continuation EMA cannot be reconstructed. Never claim new diagnostics repair missing historical records.

reporting.unchanged: Retain original48 endpoints and all strength-grid findings, desk-rejection history, two authors/no funding/ORCID, dataset reuse/provenance and AI author-review status.
reporting.claims: Learning-rate interaction under the tested late-training regime, not proof of why all KD works/fails, no positive-control success assumption, no new algorithm or deployment speedup. Same detector family and datasets remain limits.
reporting.public_reproducibility: Prepare persistent access plan and public checkpoint/prediction artifacts where permitted, verify all publication bytes; do not expose credentials or redistribute third-party images/labels without rights.
reporting.manuscript: Explain the scientific question and paired interaction first; move operational audit details to supplement. Reassess contribution and journal fit based on all outcomes. Render every Word/PDF page.
